SELECT p.penalty_id AS penaltyId ,p.target_user_id AS targetUserId ,u.nickname AS account ,u.email AS email ,p.report_id AS reportId ,p.penalty_type AS penaltyType ,p.start_at AS startAt ,p.end_at AS endAt ,p.status AS status ,p.reason AS reason ,(p.status = '적용 중' AND (p.end_at IS NULL OR p.end_at > #{now})) AS active FROM penalty p JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = p.target_user_id
(u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(p.report_id AS CHAR) = #{keyword} OR p.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.status = '적용 중' AND (p.end_at IS NULL OR p.end_at > #{now})
AND (p.status = '만료' OR (p.status = '적용 중' AND p.end_at IS NOT NULL AND p.end_at <= #{now}))
AND p.status = '해제'
ORDER BY p.start_at DESC, p.penalty_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.target_user_id) FROM penalty p WHERE p.penalty_type = '이용 제한' AND p.status = '적용 중' AND (p.end_at IS NULL OR p.end_at > #{now})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penalty p WHERE p.penalty_type = '경고'

SELECT p.penalty_id AS penaltyId ,p.target_user_id AS targetUserId ,p.report_id AS reportId ,p.issued_by AS issuedBy ,p.penalty_type AS penaltyType ,p.start_at AS startAt ,p.end_at AS endAt ,p.status AS status ,p.reason AS reason ,p.released_by AS releasedBy ,p.released_at AS releasedAt FROM penalty p WHERE p.penalty_id = #{penaltyId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.penalty_id AS penaltyId ,p.target_user_id AS targetUserId ,p.report_id AS reportId ,p.issued_by AS issuedBy ,p.penalty_type AS penaltyType ,p.start_at AS startAt ,p.end_at AS endAt ,p.status AS status ,p.reason AS reason ,p.released_by AS releasedBy ,p.released_at AS releasedAt FROM penalty p WHERE p.penalty_id = #{penaltyId}

SELECT p.end_at FROM penalty p WHERE p.target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND p.penalty_type = '이용 제한' AND p.status = '적용 중' AND p.end_at IS NOT NULL AND p.end_at > #{now} ORDER BY p.end_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
